name: Pistus flies
description: Mosquito-like insects of Mirrodin that now spread the Phyrexian contagion as unwitting allies of New Phyrexia.

timeline.summary: Pistus flies become unwitting allies of New Phyrexia by spreading the Phyrexian contagion.
timeline.quote: In recent times they've become an unwitting ally of New Phyrexia , as they are capable of slurping up and then spreading the Phyrexian contagion to other creatures.
